svg.title: What the latency numbers cover
svg.desc: One Binance trade from the matching engine to Kafka. Binance stamps T when it matches the trade and E when it sends it. laptime times t1 minus t0: Parse, Encode and Publish inside Stream::OnMessage, with a steady clock. A small IXWebSocket patch could time read plus TLS and WebSocket decode on the same clock, and librdkafka's Message::latency gives produce to dr_cb. The network and the kernel's wake-up are out of reach.

svg.text: One Binance trade, left to right in time. Top: where each step runs. Bottom: what laptime times today, what it could add, and what is out of reach.
